_comment: Per-handler hook timeout in SECONDS. Single source of truth for both manifests, added by Phase M (issue #54) after the Copilot sync silently dropped 16 hooks. WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: Phase L (#53) converted 16 of the 37 hooks in .claude/settings.template.json to type "mcp_tool", which carries no `timeout` -- that field belongs to the command-hook shape. But hooks.json (the Copilot CLI runtime) must stay ALL command hooks and every entry there needs a timeoutSec, so the generator had nowhere to read those 16 timeouts from and skipped the entries entirely, taking hooks.json from 37 handlers to 21. The parity guard caught it on the next full run. Rather than reintroduce a timeout field onto mcp_tool entries (a shape the docs do not describe), the value lives here once and both manifests derive from it. daemon/test/hook-inventory.unit.mjs asserts this map covers exactly the implemented handler inventory and agrees with every command hook in both files, so it cannot drift from either. Values were derived from the two manifests at the moment they agreed, never retyped.
